description: False-color satellite imagery from Spot 6, acquired on 2013-07-24, depicts a mountainous area south of Kebnekaise, Sweden, at 1.5 m resolution using a 3/4/2 band combination. The image highlights _Salix_ scrub (classified as 5.2.0 Alpine scrub land) appearing in intense reddish-brown colours, indicating dense vegetation, particularly in low-lying parts of the mountainous terrain. White and pale blue linear features and irregular patches represent exposed rock, possibly snow or sparse, non-vegetated areas. A prominent yellow arrow points to an area of _Salix_ scrub within the reddish-brown vegetation. A thin yellow line overlays the bottom right portion of the image, possibly delineating a boundary or a feature like a road or river. The image contrasts _Salix_ scrub with other visible land cover types including dwarf scrubs (class 5.1.0 Heathland and moorland) and Nordic subalpine/subarctic forests (class 3.1 Broadleaved forest), based on contextual information.
